n_rows(N) :- N = #count{ R : input(R, _, _) }.
n_cols(M) :- M = #count{ C : input(_, C, _) }.

col(0..M-1) :- n_cols(M).

% Exactly one color per output cell

output(R, C, 3) :- input(R, C, 6).

left_of_8(R, C) :- col(K), col(C), col(K) = 16, col(C) = 17, input(R, K, 8).
left_of_8(R, C) :- col(K), col(C), col(K) = 20, col(C) = 21, input(R, K, 8).

right_of_8(R, C) :- col(K), col(C), col(K) = 9, col(C) = 8, input(R, K, 8).
right_of_8(R, C) :- col(K), col(C), col(K) = 13, col(C) = 12, input(R, K, 8).

right_of_8(R, C) :- col(K), col(C), col(K) = 21, col(C) = 20, input(R, K, 8).

% Central 2's become 4 (cells that have 8 on both sides)

output(R, C, 8) :- input(R, C, 8).

% Grid dimensions
n_rows(N) :- N = #count{ R : input(R, _, _) }.
n_cols(M) :- M = #count{ C : input(_, C, _) }.
row(0..N-1) :- n_rows(N).
col(0..M-1) :- n_cols(M).

% Central cells: an 8 somewhere to the left and an 8 somewhere to the right
left8_exists(R,C) :- #count{ K : col(K), col(K) < col(C), input(R,K,8) } > 0.
right8_exists(R,C) :- #count{ K : col(K), col(K) > col(C), input(R,K,8) } > 0.
central(R,C) :- left8_exists(R,C), right8_exists(R,C).

% Is there a central 4 cell to the right of the current cell?
candidate_center_4(R,C) :- #count{ K : col(K), col(K) > col(C), input(R,K,4), central(R,K) } > 0.

% Copy colours for non‑central cells (colour 0..9, except 0 which is handled specially)
output(R,C,0) :- not central(R,C), input(R,C,0).
output(R,C,1) :- not central(R,C), input(R,C,1).
output(R,C,2) :- not central(R,C), input(R,C,2).
output(R,C,3) :- not central(R,C), input(R,C,3).
output(R,C,4) :- not central(R,C), input(R,C,4).
